item.title: Ocala TD Bank robber stabs former cellmate in jail for ‘snitching,’ homosexual advances, deputies say
item.description: A Marion County Jail inmate, who was taken into custody last year following an Ocala bank robbery, is facing an attempted murder charge after he confessed to stabbing his former cellmate for "snitching" and making homosexual advances.
